# Surface energy calculation for Aluminum [0,0,1]

# From LAMMPS simulations

E_surface = -1631.81096843743  # eV
area = 407.8238886225  # Angstrom^2

print(f"Surface energy: {E_surface} eV")
print(f"Energy difference: {delta_E} eV")
print(f"Surface area: {area} Å²")

# Surface energy (divide by 2 for two surfaces)
